name: Katsuragi Yuri
source:
Ariko's mother. Whereabouts still unknown.

Mentally unstable to begin with, she loses her stability when she loses her husband Hisao. Through meeting Takemura, she believed she'd be able to find new happiness, but...

Sensitive and receptive, her richness in emotion seems to have been inherited by Ariko.

[From in-game profile]
